commitResults.messageBody:
Add n/ substring matching and reuse the filter predicate for the legacy find alias. Validate blank and duplicate criteria, and update usage and documentation.

Remove existing duplicate addGroup declarations in the model and test stub so this commit compiles. No test cases are added or updated.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add contact-type filtering with role prefixes
commitResults.messageBody: Resolve case-insensitive ct/ values and unambiguous prefixes to student, guardian, or colleague roles. Combine the role criterion with existing filters using AND and document the distinction from tags.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add partial department filtering for colleagues
commitResults.messageBody: Accept case-insensitive d/ substrings and combine them with the other filter criteria. Safely exclude non-colleagues and colleagues without departments, and update command usage and documentation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove legacy find command in favour of filter
commitResults.messageBody:
Remove the find command, parser, old name predicate, and their obsolete dedicated tests. Adapt shared test helpers and existing filter assertions while preserving partial name searches through filter n/.

Verified all 348 remaining tests and production/test Checkstyle checks pass in an isolated snapshot.

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove find command from project documentation
commitResults.messageBody: Remove the retired find alias from the user guide, command summary, developer guide, and sample portfolio. Delete the unused find-result screenshot and describe name searches through filter n/NAME.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add tests for extended filter command
commitResults.messageBody:
The filter command supports name, contact type and department criteria,
but its tests mainly cover address and tag filtering.

Missing coverage makes regressions in the new matching rules harder to
detect after replacing find with filter.

Add 44 tests across parsing, predicate, criteria and command execution
layers. Cover role prefixes, substring matching, AND combinations,
invalid inputs, missing departments and filter replacement.

Retain address and tag regression checks and the assertion that find
remains an unknown command.
Add tests for extended filter command
